gameMenu.title: Game menu
gameMenu.reportSubtitle: No one in the group will know

report.title: What's wrong with this dilemma?
report.note: The team will review it. No one in the group will know you reported it.

reportSent.text: The team will review it; no one in the group knows.
reportSent.canSkip: If you'd rather not answer it, you can skip it.

revealEarly.title: Reveal the dilemma now?

revealEarly.body_other: {{count, number}} players haven't answered yet. They'll count as “didn't vote” on this dilemma and won't be able to answer it anymore.

newHost.title: You're the host now

newHost.left: {{host}} has left the game. Your options are in the ⋮ menu.

lateJoin.illustration: La Palanca, next to a railway junction

lateJoin.onlyVote: In this game you only vote: you don't predict, no one predicts your vote and you're not on the leaderboard.

lobby.waiting: Waiting for more people. Share the code or the link so they can join.

settings.title: Game settings
settings.nominalHint: The reveal shows what each person voted, and you play at predicting it.
settings.anonymousHint: No one will see who voted what. No predictions or points: just voting.

adultsOnly.label: Over-18s only
adultsOnly.hint: Allows adult dilemmas. Only over-18s will be able to join.

settings.categoriesHint: The game mixes dilemmas from the selected categories.
settings.timeHint: Each dilemma is revealed when everyone has answered or its time runs out.

newDilemmas.label: Include new dilemmas
newDilemmas.hint: You help rate dilemmas that have just joined the catalog.

dilemmasPerPlayer.label: Dilemmas each player adds
dilemmasPerPlayer.hint: The host too. They count towards the number of dilemmas, and no one will know whose each one is until the reveal.

settings.byHandHint: The game plays these and the ones players add, with no categories or new dilemmas. “By category” clears them in one tap.
